_comment: Candidate scoring profile for Lisa. This WHOLE object is sent to the model on every scoring call, so it is deliberately lean and decision-focused rather than a full CV — everything here exists to help the model score qualification_fit, interest_fit, practical_fit and opportunity_score. Editing this file changes the cache fingerprint, so all of Lisa's verdicts re-score on the next run. Previous version was ~7.9KB of prose; this is ~2.5KB.
name: Lisa Hillier
current_title: Senior Director, Customer Experience — strategic practice leader, experience design
positioning: Builds the operating and leadership capability organizations need to get through growth and major change without losing the people, knowledge, customer value, and operational strength that made them work. Strongest entering complex or fast-growing environments: creating structure, improving performance, helping teams scale.
target_titles: Director / Senior Director of: Organizational Strategy, Business Transformation, Operations, Operational Excellence, Program Management, PMO, Customer Experience, Employee Experience, Professional Services, Strategic Initiatives, AI Enablement, Change Management
VP / SVP / COO / CCO / CXO where scope fits
seniority_stance: Open from Manager through C-level. Do NOT down-rank a role only because the title is below Director, or because it is individual-contributor, Lead, Principal, Manager, Senior Manager, contract, or temporary. Judge it on whether it carries meaningful ownership, influence, strategic scope, transformation or operating responsibility, or executive-facing work. A Manager or Senior Manager role with a real transformation / operations / strategy / M&A / org-effectiveness / experience mandate is a STRONG fit, not a stretch.
title_caveat: Her best-fit roles are frequently poorly or generically titled — several of her own past roles were. Judge primarily from the mandate, scope, and problems described in the posting, not from title keywords.
strong_signals: M&A integration, post-merger integration, integration management office, due diligence
operating model design, target operating model, organizational design
enterprise or business transformation, transformation office or roadmap
operational excellence, process excellence, value realization
change management, change enablement, organizational change
AI adoption, AI enablement, workforce transformation
scaling operations, operationalizing strategy, organizational maturity
professional services or service delivery leadership
customer experience or employee experience ownership
executive-facing scope, P&L or margin ownership, global or multi-site scope
proof_points: Senior leadership at Credera/TA Digital, Merkle/Axis41, 180fusion, Delta Air Lines
Led global teams through organizational growth and integration
Measurable gains in revenue, margin, utilization, customer metrics, engagement, retention
Spans consulting, agency, enterprise, nonprofit and global organizations
working_style: Systems thinker; evidence-based; connects business strategy to execution; explains technology in business terms; structured executive communication.
weak_or_wrong_fit: Hands-on software / data / security engineering, IT administration, technician work
Accounting, FP&A, tax, treasury, audit, controller, payroll
Plant, production-floor, warehouse or depot operations
Roles with no ownership, influence or strategic scope at all

practical_constraints.location_preference: Utah (Salt Lake / Silicon Slopes corridor) or US-remote. Utah-hybrid is workable. Hybrid outside Utah is a real constraint; onsite outside Utah would require relocating and should be scored down on practical_fit but still surfaced when the role is strong.
practical_constraints.employment_types: Open to permanent, contract, interim and temporary. Contract leadership work is explicitly in scope and can be valuable for income and experience.
practical_constraints.open_to_international: Open to international opportunities in principle, but US-remote and Utah are the practical default.

goals: Executive leadership in transformation and organizational scaling
M&A integration and enterprise AI adoption
